subject: generalized dynamic regression model with not independent coefficients

messages.author: 678b515b89104b63
messages.subject: generalized dynamic regression model with not independent coefficients
parts:
Good morning,

I am going through Ruiz-Cardenas et al (2010) paper available on this site (http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/papers/Ruiz_Krainski_Rue_TR_23112010.pdf) and looking at their example 2 (generalized dynamic regression model) to familiarize myself on how to use INLA with dynamic models. They are assuming that the three betas are independent. Reducing their model to only one covariate, how would one modify their Rcode example so that independency is not assumed? In other terms, what if the intercept and slope coefficient were correlated (the error matrix having a structure W0, W1 on the diagonal but the covariance W01 was not zero)?

My apologies if this was explained in another part of the forum. I did search through the forum through key words but i could not find how to get INLA to do this.

Thank you.

SP

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] generalized dynamic regression model with not independent coefficients
parts:
Hi,

In order to have it you have to induce correlation between two random walk priors. There are ways to do it in INLA. However, I'm not sure if it gives the same/equivalent prior as the one you want.

best,

Elias
